hooks.command: terminal-notify -title "Claude Code - $(basename "$PWD")" -subtitle "Input Required" -message "Claude is waiting for your input" -sound default
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read file_path; npm run lint:fix:file -- "$file_path"; npm run prettier:write:file -- "$file_path"; }
if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ]; then bunx github:justinhaaheim/justin-sdk setup-env; else bunx @justinhaaheim/justin-sdk doctor --quiet || true; fi
